name: github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: HyperShell requires UnprocessableEntity (HTTP 422) to reject semantically invalid requests such as an AgentRuntime selector without a repository_id (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#64), and the restored RegisterPrefixedRoutes used to mount ADLC extension kinds under /api/hypershell/ext (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#62, inadvertently removed by #58 and restored by #65). This commit (released as v0.0.35) also carries the gRPC transport security fix (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#54), JWT issuer and audience validation (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#52), and fail-closed signed-token verification (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#53). The framework moved its Go module to components/api-server (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#45) and publishes no tag for that module path (the v0.0.35 tag versions only the repo-root module), so a pseudo-version is required. The commit merged to main as 071bd1d and is under the 14 day minimum age until 2026-10-24; remove this age note then if no newer pin replaced it.
compensatingVerification: The dependency is commit-pinned; API server formatting, vet, golangci-lint, unit tests, and integration tests run against that exact commit.
